name: ai-atomic-workflow
description: Graph-Engineering for Real Engineers: Graphs define workflows; workflows build graphs. Based on mattpocock/skills.

scripts.check: bun check:dist && bun check:manifests && bun check:residue && bun typecheck && bun lint && bun format:check
scripts.check:dist: bun run build && bun vitest run packages/graph-fidelity/test/dist-smoke.test.ts
scripts.publish: bun publish --cwd packages/platform-hooks-sdk --access public && bun publish --cwd packages/graph-scheduler --access public && bun publish --cwd packages/graph-workflow --access public && bun publish --cwd packages/graph-fidelity --access public
scripts.publish:dry: bun publish --cwd packages/platform-hooks-sdk --access public --dry-run && bun publish --cwd packages/graph-scheduler --access public --dry-run && bun publish --cwd packages/graph-workflow --access public --dry-run && bun publish --cwd packages/graph-fidelity --access public --dry-run
